verdict.rationale: Flutterwave's own marketing says it can generate professional invoices that customers pay online, which covers the core of invoicing with online payment. Nothing in the evidence shows automatic reminders, and the hosted-invoice experience is documented in only one thin line. Payment links and hosted checkout pages are related features, not invoicing, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: automatic payment reminders, documentation of the hosted invoice page and its delivery, invoice-specific docs or API, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can send hosted invoices with online payment and automatic reminders

citations.quote: Generate professional invoices for your customers and get paid from anywhere.
